summary: First-pass comprehensive testing of TaxMaster Pro (React + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend: 21/21 pytest tests pass covering health, auth (register/login/logout/wrong-pw/me), country CRUD with admin RBAC, Indian + country quizzes, quiz submit with achievement unlock, leaderboard, and Claude Sonnet 4.5 SSE streaming. Frontend: all 8 pages verified end-to-end via Playwright — landing, register→dashboard redirect, admin login shows Admin Panel nav, quiz option pick shows feedback and streams progress, world explorer loads 48 countries with search/region/detail/quiz, save-smart India + general calculators produce results, leaderboard renders rows, admin panel lists 48 countries with edit dialog + save, chatbot widget opens, sends prompt, and receives Claude reply.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid uses c.region (e.g., 'edit-Asia') which collides across multiple countries in same region. Use c.key (URL-encoded) for unique testids.
data-testid={`country-card-${c.region}`} is non-unique across countries sharing a region.

issues: AuthContext eagerly calls GET /api/auth/me on every route including /, producing 4 console 401 errors for anonymous users. Consider skipping /me when no cookie is present, or catch quietly to keep console clean.

action_items: (Optional/low) Make Admin Panel edit/delete + Explorer card data-testid unique by using c.key instead of c.region to avoid selector collisions.
(Optional) Suppress benign /auth/me 401 noise for anonymous visitors on the public landing route.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: /api/quiz/submit uses two update_one calls to update best_streak conditionally then always sets current_streak — could be combined; minor perf issue only.
Backend: chat_service catches all exceptions into a single 'data: [ERROR]' SSE line — good for stream stability, but consider logging the exception for observability.
Frontend: AuthContext.refresh always calls /auth/me even on public routes and generates 401s in console. Not a bug but adds noise.
Frontend: AdminPanel edit/delete testids not unique across rows (uses region). Also c.region is used as React key for country cards in Explorer which can cause duplicate key warnings.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows verified (Landing, Register, Login admin+wrong-pw, Dashboard, IndianQuiz, WorldExplorer with search+detail+quiz, SaveSmart, Leaderboard, AdminPanel with edit-save, Chatbot streaming)

test_credentials: Admin admin@taxmaster.pro / Admin@123 works. Fresh users created via /register (qauser+<ts>@test.com / TestPass1) also work.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeded 48 countries and admin user automatically on startup. Test users created dynamically per test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (https). Cookies are secure+samesite=none so use HTTPS in tests. requests.Session persists cookies across calls. For chat streaming use stream=True and read SSE 'data:' lines until '[DONE]'. Admin nav-admin selector requires waiting for user.role to hydrate after login — always wait_for_selector('[data-testid="nav-admin"]') rather than immediate query. AdminPanel edit/delete testids collide by region so use edit-btns[0] not by specific region name.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional defects found. Only minor non-blocking observations documented above.
